WEAPON ANTI-SLOP: fantasy construction only; crossbow must NEVER read as firearm (no barrel/magazine/stock/Uzi/SMG silhouette = REJECT); anti-slop negatives always appended
BOSS FACE: Mal'garot HAS a prolific molten-lava face (lava dripping/running, drops falling to ground); faceless boss sheets SUPERSEDED
LOCATION BRIGHTNESS FLOOR: environment plates silhouette-readable at thumbnail; no murk-dark grades
